target.title: fix(openai): bound realtime voice websocket payload at 16 MiB
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The OpenAI realtime voice provider creates a WebSocket connection to the
voice API without an explicit `maxPayload`, relying on the `ws` library's
default of 100 MiB. A misbehaving endpoint could send oversized voice frames
that exhaust gateway memory.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add `maxPayload: OPENAI_VOICE_WS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` (16 MiB) to the
WebSocket constructor, consistent with the 16 MiB cap used across other
bounded-resource fixes on main.

## Evidence

The constant and `maxPayload` option are added in `realtime-voice-provider.ts`:

```text
$ grep -n "OPENAI_VOICE_WS_MAX_PAYLOAD\|maxPayload" extensions/openai/realtime-voice-provider.ts
95:const OPENAI_VOICE_WS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
570:          maxPayload: OPENAI_VOICE_WS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES,
```

The `ws` library enforces `maxPayload` internally — real behavior proof shows
oversized frames are rejected:

```text
RangeError: Max payload size exceeded
    at Receiver.haveLength (.../ws/lib/receiver.js:441:28)
    code: 'WS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_MESSAGE_LENGTH',
    Symbol(status-code): 1009
```
